name: N.E.W. Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The top prize of New Extreme Wrestling, won in a Four Way Dance at Friday Night Slam Dance after the reigning champion suffered a knee injury mid-match.

name: N.E.W. Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Changed hands in a Crucifix Match at King of the Mat 2, the loser tied to a crucifix suspended above the ring.

name: N.E.W. North American Championship
epitaph: Defended at King of the Mat 2 in a match twice interrupted before a masked ally settled it.

name: N.E.W. Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by newcomers the Crash Test Dummies in a tournament final at King of the Mat 2, over two members of a top singles stable.
